card.fires_on: Negative on the closing piece of a split name or acronym, such as the AD in CDAD, ost in belinostat, EM in JEMPERLI, and line in Hotline. It also appears on a few small words like "with" or "CV" in running text.

modes.description: The last piece of a split acronym or drug name, just before the rest of the sentence continues.
